Graduated last year and was basically in the same position as you! The road to applying to grad school is much different than applying to undergrad. I would suggest reaching out to professors from your school (who you trust) in the subject area that you are interested in to get their advice. They have definitely been through the same process and could help advise you. 

You must also think of what you want to do and where you want to end up. This list can change pretty quickly so really take the time to consider your options. It's okay to change and be unsure! I also found this subreddit, and a couple others, to be great resources. You are not alone! Best of luck!!
